scope: Conservative net-saving estimates on Traffic Receipts only. Never used for routing decisions or the explicit pricing catalog.
tier: Gemini Developer API, Standard paid tier, text input. Batch, Flex and Priority tiers, audio input and Vertex AI prices are not priced here.
notes: Keys use Entroly's provider name for Google traffic, 'gemini'.

cache_read_per_million is the page's context-caching price per token. The hourly storage price of an explicit cache is not modelled: an explicit cache is addressed by name, so Entroly's edits neither create nor break one.
No cache-write premium is published, so written tokens are priced at the input rate.
long_context applies when the request's prompt exceeds 200,000 tokens, as the page states.
